name: Wireless Noise-Cancelling Headphones

description: Compact in-ear earbuds with sweat resistance for workouts, touch controls and a charging case providing 24 hours of total playback.

description: Durable nylon-braided USB-C to USB-C cable supporting 60 W fast charging and 480 Mbps data transfer.

description: Ergonomic wireless mouse with silent clicks, adjustable DPI up to 2400 and an 18-month battery life on a single AA battery.

description: Breathable mesh office chair with adjustable lumbar support, 3D armrests and a recline lock, designed for long working hours.

description: Fitness smartwatch with heart-rate and SpO2 tracking, built-in GPS, 100+ workout modes and up to 10 days of battery life. Water resistant for swimming.

description: 1080p 30 fps USB webcam with dual noise-reducing microphones, auto light correction and a privacy shutter for video calls and online classes.

name: Wi-Fi 6 Dual-Band Router
description: AX3000 dual-band Wi-Fi 6 router with four antennas, gigabit ports and parental controls. Covers a three-bedroom home.

name: Adjustable Laptop Stand
description: Aluminium laptop stand with six height levels for 10 to 17 inch laptops. Improves posture and airflow; folds flat for travel.

name: 65W GaN Fast Charger
description: Compact 65 W GaN wall charger with two USB-C ports and one USB-A port. Charges a laptop, phone and earbuds at the same time.

name: Soundbar with Wireless Subwoofer
description: 2.1 channel 160 W soundbar with a wireless subwoofer, Dolby Audio, HDMI ARC and Bluetooth for TV and movie nights.
